/bin/bash -lc "cat > packages/drive-store/zustand/share/getExistingEmails.ts <<'EOF'
import type { ShareExternalInvitation, ShareInvitation, ShareMember } from '../../store';

export const getExistingEmails = (
    members: ShareMember[],
    invitations: ShareInvitation[],
    externalInvitations: ShareExternalInvitation[]
): string[] => [
    ...members.map((member) => member.email),
    ...invitations.map((invitation) => invitation.inviteeEmail),
    ...externalInvitations.map((invitation) => invitation.inviteeEmail),
];
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
p='packages/drive-store/zustand/share/invitations.store.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s += \"\\nexport { getExistingEmails } from './getExistingEmails';\\n\"
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node_modules/.bin/jest --config packages/drive-store/jest.config.js --runInBand packages/drive-store/zustand/share/shareStores.test.ts"
